purpose: Offline Windows WebView2 lifecycle extension, §35.2 block02
v1: Byte-intact original codec/evidence remain v1; 8 bootstrap args select health-only v1. v2 selected by trusted Infrastructure bootstrap, no protocol fallback.
transport: Existing local ACL/PID-bound Windows Named Pipe; LE uint32 length + UTF-8 JSON

commands.handshake: Exact host/owner/session/protocol correlation; features ping/cancel/shutdown/offline_lifecycle only; activeWebAvailable=false is NOT a productive snapshot.
commands.session_create: Host-owned environment and unique ephemeral UDF, no page content
commands.page_create: Host-owned hidden controller; initial about:blank; no navigation
commands.runtime_metadata: Bounded engine/SDK/process/settings identity, private Infrastructure evidence, no authority
commands.page_close: Close controller; does NOT claim whole UDF/process cleanup
commands.session_close: All owned controls/processes exited, UDF removal confirmed, else typed failure

payloadRule: Lifecycle request payload is exactly {command}; pageRef only for page_* commands. URI/script/selector/path/credentials/grants/approvals extra fields rejected.
lifecycle: NOT_STARTED → STARTING → READY → STOPPING → STOPPED; faults → FAILED / CLEANUP_UNCONFIRMED, no restart/retry or Playwright fallback.
deadlines: Closed per-request deadline, capped at30s. Timeout/cancel/disconnect discards result and invalidates client. Emergency termination/cleanup has separately bounded maintenance; never claims cancellation rollback or successful resource operation.
authority: Application/ToolRuntime/Policy/Approval/Grant remain Python-side; lifecycle messages carry no authority. Host is Infrastructure only.
deferred: No navigation, ExternalProtocolGuard, observations/actions/refs freshness, transfers/takeover, network certification, snapshotv2/productive wiring/AW8.
